CRAWFORD, COLORADO — 40 ACRES, LIVE WATER & HAY GROUND

38832 Fruitland Mesa Road | Crawford, CO
Offered at $895,000

This is the kind of Western Colorado property that’s getting harder and harder to find — 40 acres, productive irrigated ground, incredible mountain views, live water, substantial outbuildings, and a beautifully updated single-level home.

The 3-bedroom, 3-bath, 2,664± sq. ft. ranch-style home has been thoughtfully updated with new exterior steel siding, fresh interior paint, newer plank flooring, granite countertops, upgraded fixtures, central A/C and an inviting open-concept kitchen and living area.

And outside is where this property really shines.

Property highlights include:

40± acres
940 shares of Fruitland Irrigation
High-production hay ground & irrigated pasture
A private canyon with live-water creek
Two large barns
2,500 sq. ft. equipment shed
360 sq. ft. shop with 220 power
Oversized attached 2-car garage + detached garage
Multiple additional storage buildings
Shooting & sporting clay range with its own outdoor office/lounge
Owned 1,000-gallon propane tank
High-speed Elevate fiber internet
Sweeping mountain, valley and water views

Whether you’re looking for a working farm, hobby ranch, recreational retreat, horse property, or simply more room to live the Colorado lifestyle, this property offers an exceptional combination of usable acreage, water, infrastructure and scenery.
